briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek-R2 accelerate frontier race as compute constraints tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: AI development velocity remains elevated with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced reasoning models. Funding continues flowing into infrastructure while safety concerns mount around multi-agent deployments. Regulatory scrutiny intensifies in US and EU.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with enhanced multi-step reasoning while Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 and xAI launched Grok-3. DeepSeek-R2 achieved near-parity on key benchmarks at lower cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Google and Microsoft announced new 100k H100-equivalent clusters. TSMC reports sustained demand for next-gen AI accelerators through 2027. Energy constraints now limit training runs in several regions.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first system to reach 90th percentile on SWE-bench also demonstrate reliable long-horizon agentic behavior?
